title: Electrolysis: qualitative aspect
notes: **Scope.** Electrolysis: qualitative aspect — Oxidation and Reduction, Chemistry (class-11-notes).
**Tested.** define it · list: electrolysis, qualitative aspect · one worked example · one misconception each.
**Fact.** Electrochemical cell E = E_cathode − E_anode; ΔG = −nFE. Standard: 25 °C, 1 M, 1 atm.
**Fact.** Nernst: E = E° − (RT/nF) ln Q; at 25 °C E = E° − (0.0592/n) log Q.
**Fact.** Faraday: m = (M/F)·Q (1 F = 96500 C mol⁻¹); 1 F deposits 1/valency mole of an ion.
